model_output.rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial on both lines. However, the 277CA proves the payer received the claim on 2025-01-27 (status A2, accepted for adjudication) — only 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19. This is well within any commercial filing limit. The 837P interchange date of 2025-10-15 suggests a resubmission triggered the denial, but the original was timely. Per reference 03-timely-filing.md: proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal disputing the receipt date.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 on both lines. Payer asserts filing limit expired, but 277CA shows claim received 2025-01-27 (A2 accepted for adjudication), only 8 days after DOS 2025-01-19. The later 837P dated 2025-10-15 likely triggered the denial; original submission was timely.

next_action.detail: Appeal disputing the receipt date. Attach the 277CA acceptance report (received 2025-01-27, status A2/code 20) as proof of timely filing. Do not plead forgiveness — assert the claim was received within the window.

evidence.fact: Both lines denied CO-29 (timely filing expired); MOA N211 at claim level
Claim received 2025-01-27 (DTP 050), status A2 accepted for adjudication, code 20 accepted for processing
DOS 2025-01-19; interchange date 2025-10-15 indicates a resubmission 9 months later
Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report, dispute the receipt date

citations.rule: Proof of an accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report: dispute the receipt date, don't plead forgiveness
CO = contractual obligation, provider liable, never bill patient
